name: explorium_mcp_api_key_setup
summary: Obtain an Explorium API key from the admin portal for authenticating the Explorium MCP server.
steps: Navigate to admin.explorium.ai/api-key.
Sign up for a free trial account (no credit card required).
Generate and copy the API key string.
jarvis_use: Acquire credentials required to connect n8n workflows or agents to Explorium's B2B data MCP server.

name: n8n_mcp_client_tool_sse_configuration
summary: Configure an n8n MCP Client Tool node to connect to Explorium via Server-Sent Events (SSE) and Header Authentication.
steps: Add an MCP Client Tool node to the n8n canvas.
Set SSE Endpoint to https://mcp.explorium.ai/sse.
Set Authentication to Header Auth.
Create a Header Auth credential with Header Name set to api-key and Value set to the Explorium API key.
Set Tools to Include to All to expose all Explorium tools to the agent.
jarvis_use: Enable LLM agents inside n8n to call Explorium firmographic data lookup tools directly via standard MCP.

name: agent_prompt_firmographic_enrichment_pattern
summary: Prompt an AI agent to execute a two-step lookup using MCP tools to resolve business identifiers before extracting firmographics.
steps: Supply company name and domain in the user input context.
Instruct the AI Agent to first use Explorium search tools to match the business name and locate its unique business_id.
Instruct the agent to use the retrieved business_id to query and enrich detailed firmographic data (annual revenue, employee count, NAICS code).
jarvis_use: Guide LLM agents through structured multi-step API/MCP tool calling sequences for reliable database entity resolution.

name: structured_output_parser_schema_alignment
summary: Attach a Structured Output Parser node to an n8n AI Agent output port to enforce JSON fields that match target spreadsheet columns.
steps: Add a Structured Output Parser node to the n8n workflow.
Connect it to the Output Parser input port of the AI Agent node.
Define schema key names identical to target spreadsheet headers (name, website, business_id, naics, number_of_employees_range, yearly_revenue_range).
jarvis_use: Eliminate conversational LLM output noise and guarantee strict schema compliance for automated database writing.

name: n8n_code_node_output_formatter
summary: Pass structured output through a JavaScript Code node to clean and format output JSON for visual node mapping.
steps: Add a Code node directly after the AI Agent / Output Parser output.
Include a simple JavaScript mapping function returning standardized item JSON objects.
Expose clean property handles for drag-and-drop mapping into downstream integration nodes.
jarvis_use: Format agent outputs into predictable top-level JSON keys for seamless visual mapping in downstream workflow nodes.

name: google_sheets_in_place_row_lookup_update
summary: Update target rows in Google Sheets by matching against a primary key column instead of appending duplicates.
steps: Add a Google Sheets node to the n8n canvas.
Set Resource to Sheet Within Document.
Set Operation to Append or Update Row.
Specify target Document and Sheet.
Set Column to match on to a unique key field (e.g., name or website).
Map formatted JSON attributes to target column headers.
jarvis_use: Enrich existing spreadsheet records in-place without creating duplicate entry rows.

name: n8n_empty_row_filter_guard
summary: Insert a Filter node after database trigger nodes to prevent executing agent workflows on blank rows.
steps: Connect a Filter node to the Google Sheets trigger node.
Set filter condition to check if target input field (e.g., company name) is not empty.
Pass only passing execution branches into the batch loop.
jarvis_use: Save LLM tokens and API calls by validating that spreadsheet rows contain essential inputs before agent invocation.

name: n8n_sequential_batch_looping
summary: Loop over incoming dataset rows with batch size 1 to prevent API rate limit breaches and state contamination during LLM tool calls.
steps: Add a Loop Over Items node in n8n.
Configure batch size parameter to 1.
Route individual items through the AI Agent processing sub-workflow.
Route the final action node output back into the input of the Loop Over Items node to proceed sequentially.
jarvis_use: Isolate state and process tabular datasets row-by-row when running multi-step LLM tool calls.
